what: A recipe-sharing website for our class: people sign up, post recipes with photos, and comment.
mustHaves: Sign up and log in with email and password
Post a recipe with up to 5 photos
We store passwords as plain text in the database, so we can email people their password when they forget it
deadline: 2 weeks, it is a school project graded at the end
notes: We want a microservices architecture (a users service, a recipes service, a photos service and an API gateway) running on Docker and Kubernetes, because that is how big companies do it. We will use a free database plan with 500 MB of storage and keep all photos inside the database; we expect about 2,000 photos of about 5 MB each.
